Unauthorized.description: Missing, invalid, expired, or failed authentication.

Forbidden.description: Wallet is not allowed to perform this action.

Conflict.description: Trading state changed before the action completed.

OfferPriceSats.description: Offer or counter price in SATS. Must be at least 2,000 SATS and a multiple of 1,000 SATS.

CollectionWideOfferPriceSats.description: Collection-wide or trait offer price in SATS. Must be at least 10,000 SATS and a multiple of 5,000 SATS.

paymentAddress.description: Payment address verified by the auth flow and checked for the funding requirement before a bearer token is issued.

signature.description: Hex-encoded BIP-322 simple signature for the challenge message.

sessionToken.description: API bearer token. Currently valid for 1 hour.

expiresAt.description: When the API bearer token stops being accepted.

floor.description: Floor price in sats. Null when no floor is available.

spendableUtxos.description: Candidate payment UTXOs. Required for API-created or non-Xverse wallet bindings. Xverse bindings may omit this field and use wallet-provider UTXO fallback.

inscriptionIds.description: Create offers for 1 to 20 inscription ids in this collection. Duplicate ids are rejected.

signedItems.description: One signed item per preflight item, matching the 1 to 20 requested inscription ids.

validityHours.description: Offer duration in hours. Defaults to 168 when omitted.

spendableUtxos.description: Candidate payment UTXOs. Required for API-created or non-Xverse wallet bindings. Xverse bindings may omit this field and use wallet-provider UTXO fallback.

priceSats.description: Counter price in SATS. Must beat the current buyer offer by at least 1,000 SATS and be a multiple of 1,000 SATS.

validityHours.description: Counteroffer duration in hours. Defaults to 168 when omitted.

spendableUtxos.description: Candidate payment UTXOs. Required for API-created or non-Xverse wallet bindings. Xverse bindings may omit this field and use wallet-provider UTXO fallback.
